steps: Serve the unchanged production dist build over http://127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port.
Open a clean Chromium context at 1440 × 1000, en-US, UTC, device scale 1.
Click Begin expedition with the default Field trip pace.
Use F four times to throw Ember scouts at the initial Navigation prism target, then allow them to lift and carry it toward the landing nest.
notes: Real public-control gameplay, locally served production artifact; browser pixels unedited. No save/state injection, no simulated screenshot, no deployed-build equivalence claimed.
